caption: The input A and its transpose Aᵀ. All three off-diagonal pairs (2↔4, 3↔7, 6↔8) swap together in one PRAM step; the diagonal 1, 5 and 9 stay put.

spec.title: Transpose of A in one PRAM step
spec.aria: Two rows of nine cells: the input 3×3 matrix A and its transpose Aᵀ. The off-diagonal values 2,3,4,6,7,8 are marked to show they swap in three pairs; the diagonal 1,5,9 are marked as staying.
